I'd suggest a controlled experiment: keep PPR 1.91 running and send the same short test at different Thinking settings. Then try a question requiring a longer response.
If it consistently works at one setting and fails at another, we've found a valuable clue.
No code changes yet. Just evidence. 😁☕💜
